checks.name: carrier_provenance
checks.detail: build_estimator_k22r.py pins BASE to ../public_condrepair_deployment_card_v3/estimator.py with BASE_SHA equal to the base arm's sha and asserts it before patching. Each of the 7 replacement anchors occurs exactly once in the base (verified independently). Reconstructing base + the 7 declared replacements + the appended carrier block reproduces estimator_k22r.py byte-for-byte (reconstructed sha256 == on-disk sha256 == 0ecbbd49...), so the diff contains ONLY the declared changes: R1 factor-at-reset emission, R2-R5 tuple plumbing, R6 pushed-plane adds into pre_k4/pre_k31/pre_k22, R7 final-layer k4-diagonal consume, plus appended _factor_k22_residual/_push_k22_residual/_push_k22_residual_diagonal with K22R_RANK=4. Structural intent (rank-4 K22-residual carrier only) confirmed; the formula defect inside the appended push is recorded under math_spot_check.

checks.name: math_spot_check
checks.detail: For the symmetric iijj-family tensor (T[perm(i,i,j,j)]=Q[i,j], Q symmetric zero-diagonal), exact transport was computed as np.einsum('ijkl,ia,jb,kc,ld->abcd') in float64 with .copy() on every extracted view, cross-checked by an einsum-free quadruple loop, with the code's expressions replicated verbatim using an exact eigendecomposed Q (d = true diagonal) and also a rank-4 truncation (nonzero d, exercising the spurs). RESULT: k4 channel and final-layer diagonal push EXACT (max rel err 3.9e-15) and k22 channel EXACT (max rel err 3.0e-15) in all four variants, spurs included. The k31 channel is EXACTLY DOUBLE the true transported channel: estimator_k22r.py line 8631 emits 6.0*s_one - 6.0*spur, while the exact entry channel T'[a,a,a,b] = 3*sum_{i!=j} Q_ij W2[i,a]W[j,a]W[j,b] (the aaab pattern has only 3 of the 6 arrangements of (i,i,j,j) placing the single leg on b). Elementwise code/exact ratio = 2.0 within 1.1e-13 across all off-diagonal entries in every variant; max rel err vs exact = 1.0, vs 2x exact = 1.3e-15. The host's plane convention is unambiguously tensor-entry value: _connected_planes measures k31[a,b] as the joint cumulant kappa(a,a,a,b); the deployed _push_quartic emits star_k31 and pairing_k31 (3*alpha*var_a*cov_ab) as exact entries; _edgeworth_weights consumes k31/k31^T as entries; and STAR_TRANSPORT_FIDELITY_PROBE_v2 (this preregistration's cited authority) validated the deployed push at ~2e-16 against the same entry-extraction reference, with k31 exact_norms nonzero for the k22-residual family. Therefore the pilot's k22r4 arm as pinned injects twice the k31 plane of the family it claims to transport exactly ('exact iijj-family transport' per its own comment); the three emitted channels are mutually inconsistent (no rescaling of the carried pattern makes all three exact). Minimal fix: change both 6.0 coefficients to 3.0 on line 8631's expression in the builder's APPENDED block, rebuild, re-pin the k22r4 sha in PREREGISTRATION.json and generate_pilot_row.py, and re-audit before any generation.

checks.name: gates_and_licensing
checks.detail: decision_gates are validity-only (mode all-for-validity: coverage 400/400 receipts, finite host/raw20/sigma, every flops_used <= 2^41; achievability is a citation, not an outcome gate). licensing_rules cover raw_improvement_at_least_10pct / raw_improvement_0_to_10pct / raw_worse plus a corrected-absorption note; no-retune is explicit twice (stage2_scoring.no_retune and firewalls.post_metric_retuning=false). resources block present (maximum_rss_bytes 8589934592, estimated_generation_wall_minutes 170) and enforced in the generator (MAX_RSS assert).

checks.name: orchestrator_sanity
checks.detail: run_generation.py iterates ranks 35..234 and spawns BOTH arms per rank as two concurrent nice-10 subprocesses (2 workers; generator caps threadpools at 2), communicates each, and on any nonzero returncode prints FAIL with the child's output and sys.exit(1) immediately - no path continues past a failed row. The generator's only skip path requires an existing result.json with status complete-target-free-k22pilot AND matching source sha; any other partial output raises. Outputs are written to a tmp dir and atomically renamed, so a killed run cannot leave a row that later reads as complete.
